### workspace repair --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace repair [project] [options]

Rebuild state from live iTerm windows.
Scans for windows with 'workspace-{name}' titles and
reconstructs the state file from what's actually running.

Options:
        --window-id WID              Manually set the window ID for a project
        --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr

Examples:
  workspace repair    # state is wrong or lost: rewrite each workspace's window id from the live workspace-NAME windows
  workspace repair --json    # the same, one action document with a row per window
  workspace repair homebrew-bin --window-id 1196    # a window has another title: set that project's window id by hand
--- stderr
--- end
